My family and I spent 3.5 weeks in Bali this July/Aug 2017. I was luckily enough to have found Studio Pilates - The Art of Body as I wanted to keep up with my pilates whilst drinking cocktails in between. Faz the owner and teacher keeps his classes small of about 3- 4 pax max which is great as he can spend time correcting us individually if need be. He gives a great workout session and pushed me hard which I totally loved. Pilates in HK has not been the same as I have yet to experience a teacher like him. I will be back in Bali next year and I will definitely be booking myself for as many sessions as I can fit in. Faz is also full of knowledge on how the body work. I just wished I had more time to learn from him. Thanks Faz for a the great experience. Looking forward to seeing the new studio when I am next in town.

If you want real pilates training and attention to every detail of your body, this is the place to be. The instructor, Faz, has a lot of knowledge in terms of anatomy, body healing techniques, posture, Bowen technique massage, cardio practice and yoga. He pays a lot of attention to the way you move and really focuses on each single person (classes are always attended by no more than 3 or 4 people so he can follow every person with care). In addition, he's a very humble and funny guy, always looking to make you feel comfortable, so your day will definitely start with a smile. This is my one stop Pilates place in Bali!

발리에서 The Art of Body 필라테스 스튜디오를 찾게 된 것과 Faz 선생님에께 수업을 받은 것은 행운이었습니다.
많은 업무와 스트레스로 인하여 몸의 밸런스가 망가져 있었습니다. 몸과 마음이 많이 지쳐있던 차에, 잠시 휴식을 가지고자 발리로 긴 휴가를 떠났습니다. 6주 동안 Faz 선생님과의 트레이닝은 몸의 안과 밖의 큰 변화를 주기에 충분한 시간이었습니다.
처음 필라테스를 해보았기 때문에 호흡을 배우는 것부터도 많이 어려웠지만 6주 동안 선생님께서 열정적으로 가르쳐 주신 덕분에 육안으로도 한 눈에 제 몸의 밸런스가 좋아진 것을 보고 느낄 수 있었습니다.
아직도 발리에서 필라테스 클래스를 선택하는 것에 고민이신 분들에게 저는 망설임 없이 Faz 선생님과 3번만 수업을 해보실 것을 추천드립니다.
